problem_summary.summary: Design a string set supporting insertion, exact-word membership, and prefix membership for lowercase English words.
problem_summary.input_output: Implement Trie with a constructor, insert(word), search(word), and startsWith(prefix). Insert returns nothing; both queries return booleans.
constraints: Words and prefixes use lowercase English letters

brute_force.explanation: Store inserted words in a list. Exact search scans for equality; prefix search scans for any stored word beginning with the requested prefix. This keeps the data structure simple but repeats work on every query.
brute_force.correctness_idea: The list contains every inserted string. Equality directly implements search, and startsWith is true exactly when at least one stored string begins with the supplied prefix.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(L) per insert; O(W) expected string-hash/equality work per exact search and O(WL) worst case per prefix query, where W is the number of insertions and L is word length.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(WL) for storing all inserted strings, including duplicates.

optimized.explanation: Store each character path once in a 26-child trie. Mark the final node of each inserted word; search requires that marker, while startsWith only requires reaching the prefix node.
optimized.correctness_idea: A trie path spells exactly the characters consumed from the root. A terminal marker distinguishes a complete inserted word from a prefix that only begins some longer word.
optimized.time_complexity: O(L) per insert, search, or prefix query, where L is the input string length.
optimized.space_complexity: O(T) auxiliary for trie nodes, where T is the total number of distinct character-prefix nodes and T is at most the total inserted characters plus the root.

steps.condition: The path is absent at its first character and then continues through each letter.
steps.action: Create any missing nodes and mark the final e node terminal.

steps.condition: Both strings reach existing nodes, but only apple currently has a terminal marker.
steps.action: Return true for apple and false for app.

steps.event: Check prefix app, then insert app.
steps.condition: The app path exists as the beginning of apple.
steps.action: startsWith returns true; mark the existing app node terminal on insert.

steps.condition: The app node now marks an inserted word.

edge_cases.case: A prefix path exists but is not a complete word
edge_cases.handling: startsWith returns true while search returns false until the node is marked terminal.

edge_cases.case: Insert the same word more than once
edge_cases.handling: Setting an existing terminal marker again leaves membership unchanged.

edge_cases.case: Search diverges at a missing child
edge_cases.handling: The trie query returns false immediately.
Its first child node is marked terminal and queried normally.
